example.en: A white horse was tied up outside the door.
Every day the girl fed the horse and brushed its coat.
She ran to greet her father.
Its pair of eyes was round and bright.

simp.text: 眼泪一滴滴落在马皮上。

trad.text: 眼淚一滴滴落在馬皮上。
trad.bpmf: 眼淚一󠇢滴滴落在馬皮上。

example.en: Her tears fell drop by drop onto the horse's hide.

simp.text: 她每天跑到门口好几回。

trad.text: 她每天跑到門口好幾回。
trad.bpmf: 她每天跑到門口好幾回。

example.en: Several times each day she ran to the doorway.
Like snow that had just fallen in winter.

simp.text: 对著天空长长地叫了一声。

trad.text: 對著天空長長地叫了一聲。
trad.bpmf: 對著天空長長地󠇡叫了一󠇢聲。

example.en: It lifted its face to the sky and let out one long whinny.

simp.text: 这件事像一块大石头压在她心上。

trad.text: 這件事像一塊大石頭壓在她心上。
trad.bpmf: 這件事像一󠇡塊大石頭壓在她心上。

example.en: The thought pressed on her heart like a heavy stone.

simp.text: 姑娘一回到家，走进院子。

trad.text: 姑娘一回到家，走進院子。
trad.bpmf: 姑娘一󠇢回到家，走進院子󠇡。

example.en: The moment the girl got home, she stepped into the courtyard.

simp.text: 那张马皮忽然从竹竿上滑了下来。

trad.text: 那張馬皮忽然從竹竿上滑了下來。
trad.bpmf: 那張馬皮忽然從竹竿上滑了下來。

example.en: That horse hide suddenly slid down from the bamboo pole.

simp.text: 那雪白的马皮还紧紧贴在她身上。

trad.text: 那雪白的馬皮還緊緊貼在她身上。
trad.bpmf: 那雪白的馬皮還緊緊貼在她身上。

example.en: The snow-white horse hide still clung tightly to her.

simp.text: 村子里的人在附近的树林里，找到了那个不见的姑娘。

trad.text: 村子裡的人在附近的樹林裡，找到了那個不見的姑娘。
trad.bpmf: 村子󠇡裡的人在附近的樹林裡，找到了那個󠇡不󠇡見的姑娘。

example.en: The people of the village found the missing girl in the woods nearby.

simp.text: 世界上多了一种会吐丝的小虫子。

trad.text: 世界上多了一種會吐絲的小蟲子。
trad.bpmf: 世界上多了一󠇢種會吐絲的小蟲子󠇡。

example.en: The world gained a little creature that could spin silk.

simp.text: 听说蚕花娘娘生前最爱吃小汤圆。

trad.text: 聽說蠶花娘娘生前最愛吃小湯圓。
trad.bpmf: 聽說蠶花娘娘生前最愛吃小湯圓。

example.en: It is said that the Silkworm Goddess loved to eat little sweet rice balls.

vocab.en: the Silkworm Goddess: the girl of this story, honored as the guardian spirit who watches over silkworms and the silk harvest

simp.text: 也有人称她为『蚕花娘娘』。

trad.text: 也有人稱她為『蠶花娘娘』。
trad.bpmf: 也有人稱她為『蠶花娘娘』。

example.en: Others called her the Silkworm Goddess.

simp.text: 因为她总是格外细心地照顾蚕宝宝。

trad.text: 因為她總是格外細心地照顧蠶寶寶。
trad.bpmf: 因為󠇡她總是格外細心地󠇡照顧蠶寶寶。

example.en: Because she always cared for the silkworms with special attention.

simp.text: 心里最想念的，还是远方的爸爸。

trad.text: 心裡最想念的，還是遠方的爸爸。
trad.bpmf: 心裡最想念的，還是遠方的爸爸󠇡。

example.en: The one she missed most was her father, far away.

vocab.en: a joke, something said in fun

simp.text: 才把那天跟白马开的玩笑，从头到尾地说了出来。

trad.text: 才把那天跟白馬開的玩笑，從頭到尾地說了出來。
trad.bpmf: 才把那天跟白馬開的玩笑，從頭到尾地󠇡說了出來。

example.en: She told from beginning to end the joke she had made with the white horse that day.

simp.text: 我就嫁给你，做你的新娘。

trad.text: 我就嫁給你，做你的新娘。
trad.bpmf: 我就嫁給你，做你的新娘。

example.en: I will marry you and be your bride.

vocab.en: anxious, worried and in a hurry

example.en: When her father heard it all, his heart grew even more anxious.

simp.text: 看到这一切，爸爸心里非常担心。

trad.text: 看到這一切，爸爸心裡非常擔心。
trad.bpmf: 看到這一󠇡切󠇡，爸爸󠇡心裡非常擔心。

example.en: Seeing all of this, her father was deeply worried.

vocab.en: to be reunited as a family

example.en: At last the whole family was together again.

simp.text: 一边摸著，一边伤心地大哭起来。

trad.text: 一邊摸著，一邊傷心地大哭起來。
trad.bpmf: 一󠇢邊摸著，一󠇢邊傷心地󠇡大哭起來。

example.en: Stroking the hide, she began to cry with a broken heart.

vocab.en: to stare blankly, lost in thought

simp.text: 常常一个人坐在门槛上发呆。

trad.text: 常常一個人坐在門檻上發呆。
trad.bpmf: 常常一󠇡個󠇡人坐在門檻上發呆。

example.en: She would often sit alone on the doorstep and stare into space.

simp.text: 嘴里不停地吐出一根又一根亮晶晶的细丝。

trad.text: 嘴裡不停地吐出一根又一根亮晶晶的細絲。
trad.bpmf: 嘴裡不停地󠇡吐出一󠇢根又一󠇢根亮晶晶的細絲。

example.en: From her mouth came shining thread after shining thread, without stopping.

simp.text: 院子里忽然刮起一阵旋风。

trad.text: 院子裡忽然颳起一陣旋風。
trad.bpmf: 院子󠇡裡忽然颳起一󠇡陣旋風。

example.en: A whirlwind suddenly swept up in the courtyard.
Later on, everyone held her in deep respect.

simp.text: 家家户户都会煮茧圆来感谢她的保佑。

trad.text: 家家戶戶都會煮繭圓來感謝她的保佑。
trad.bpmf: 家家戶戶都會煮繭圓來感謝她的保佑。

example.en: Every household cooks cocoon dumplings to thank her for her protection.

simp.text: 这个老风俗，一直流传到今天。

trad.text: 這個老風俗，一直流傳到今天。
trad.bpmf: 這個󠇡老風俗，一󠇢直流傳到今天。

example.en: This old custom has been handed down all the way to today.
